title: Conversations: Don't test unreachable conversations
description:
An historical confusion between NO_PORTS and NO_PORT_X lead to
testing many unreachable conversations (the ones which have at
least one port set).

Particularly Ethernet performance is impacted, and the more
conversations there are, worse the performance is.

commits_data.message:
Conversations: Don't test unreachable conversations

An historical confusion between NO_PORTS and NO_PORT_X lead to
testing many unreachable conversations (the ones which have at
least one port set).

Particularly Ethernet and IP protocols performance are impacted,
and the more conversations there are, worse the performance is.
